tldr: This thread groups three unrelated Anthropic posts that happen to share the word "through": Cognition's trust in Claude Fable 5 for unattended coding, a $200M research-funding commitment, and a voice-mode expansion. There is no single connecting story here.
whats_new: The latest post: voice mode now runs on Claude Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku, reaches connected tools, and speaks more languages.
why_it_matters: None of the three items build on each other, so treat them as independent signals: production trust for autonomous coding agents, external R&D investment, and expanded voice/tool multimodality.
